# Symbol properties

Properties of the traded instrument. PowerBridge takes them from the instrument config passed to the run (for example `get_config("NQ")`).

[Back to the keyword reference index](README.md)

### bigpointvalue

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Money value of a one-point price move for one contract, from the instrument config (20 for NQ).

```easylanguage
Vars: Risk(0);
Risk = 10 * BigPointValue;
```

### category

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Numeric asset-class code of the instrument. PowerBridge returns 0.

### Convert_Currency

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | at least 4 | not established | PowerBridge test (`tests/test_ground_check_traps.py`) | no | transpiles; the run stops (not implemented in the runtime) |

Converts an amount between currencies at a given date and time. PowerBridge's runtime does not implement it; a run that reaches it stops with an error.

### pointvalue

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Money value of the smallest price unit, which is `BigPointValue` divided by `PriceScale`.

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

How many price units make one point; for a quote with two decimals it is 100.
